ops.title: synckit artifact transfer + delivery v2 contract v1 (CAS, zstd batches, per-part policy, supersede, status)
ops.body:
# synckit artifact transfer + delivery v2 contract (v1)

Source: coordinator synthesis of mapping lanes synckit-sync-core + synckit-transport-artifacts + network-policy (Run wf_60d8895a-f7f; full reports under /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/mapping/core.md and transport.md), the implemented netpolicy package (commit 1215e002 on cc-sync/netpolicy, root-verified), and root review requirements on epic 7389668. Release target: synckit v0.40.0 (additive API; delivery state v2 with a one-shot v1 migration, no downgrade).

## 0. Root review requirements (binding)
- R1 Receiver-side live policy on every chunk: the RECEIVING consumer evaluates its own live netpolicy state on every batch begin and every part put, and refuses before writing when its own state or the sender-declared state is not unrestricted. A remote State cached by the sender never authorizes later parts. The sender also re-evaluates its own live state before every part and uses the peer state returned by the previous put.
- R2 Every ChangeID binds its artifact roots: BindDelivery with a non-empty artifact set hashes a v2 domain over the v1 inputs plus the count and each root's kind:digest:size in order, so ChangeID binds the artifact set. The receiving consumer must re-derive the root set from the decoded payload and refuse (error, no ACK) when it differs from change.Artifacts; the exporter must derive roots deterministically from the payload it exports.
- R3 A late ACK can never clear a superseding pending (ChangeID CAS on acknowledge), Acked is monotonic, and supersede runs while the peer is offline so an expired pending never pins forever.
- R4 No ACK before every root closure is durable on the receiver: the apply.v2 handler computes readiness from its own store, never from the sender.

## 1. Process ownership and byte path
- Each resident artifact consumer (cc-sync's helper under helperruntime) exclusively owns one store directory `artifact.ServiceRoot(serviceID)` = `<hostregistry.Mesh.Dir()>/artifacts/v1/<serviceID>`: capture writes, receive-side batch commits, pins, GC, and outbox batch builds all happen in that process. synckitd never opens a store.
- synckitd serve owns the peer data path: per-(service, peer) serialization, coalescing, the gate (its own netpolicy monitor + the peer's net status), closure/have/batch orchestration, supersede, delivery state, status.
- Byte path: source consumer store → local resident lane (syncservice.Resident) → synckitd → ssh `synckitd rpc-serve-v1 <svc>` (pure byte proxy) → peer consumer store. The peer's synckitd serve is not on the path; RemoteServeCommand stays the only remote command.
- Relay: host B delivers its own store contents (including A-origin artifacts) to C through the same path; A is not needed.

## 2. package artifact (public; github.com/yasyf/synckit/artifact)
```go
const (
  ChunkSize       = 1 << 20   // max blob bytes; Put splits at fixed offsets so append-only files reuse every unchanged prefix chunk
  PartSize        = 1 << 20   // max compressed bytes per transport part (one RPC put)
  MaxManifestBytes = 1 << 20
  MaxDeps         = 4096
  MaxBatchRaw     = 32 << 20  // uncompressed object bytes per batch
  MaxBatchObjects = 16384
  MaxHaveDigests  = 16384
  MaxClosurePage  = 16384
  MaxRoots        = 4096
  MaxIncoming     = 8         // concurrently staged receive batches per store
  WindowSize      = 4 << 20   // zstd encoder window == decoder max window
  StagingTTL      = 24 * time.Hour
  GCGrace         = time.Hour
)
var DefaultClosureBound = ClosureBound{MaxObjects: 1 << 18, MaxDepth: 32, MaxBytes: 64 << 30}
type Digest string // 64 lowercase hex sha256 of the object bytes
type Kind string   // "blob" | "manifest"
type Ref struct { Digest Digest `json:"digest"`; Kind Kind `json:"kind"`; Size int64 `json:"size"` } // manifest: logical content size
type ChunkRef struct { Digest Digest `json:"digest"`; Size int64 `json:"size"` }
type Manifest struct {
  Schema string     `json:"schema"` // "synckit.artifact.manifest.v1"
  Media  string     `json:"media"`  // consumer label [a-z0-9.+/-]{1,128}
  Size   int64      `json:"size"`
  Chunks []ChunkRef `json:"chunks"`
  Deps   []Ref      `json:"deps,omitempty"` // unique, ≤ MaxDeps; presence required, not content
}
type ObjectEntry struct { Digest Digest `json:"digest"`; Kind Kind `json:"kind"`; Size int64 `json:"size"` }
type ClosureBound struct { MaxObjects int; MaxDepth int; MaxBytes int64 }
type Closure struct { Objects []ObjectEntry; Bytes int64 } // DFS from roots in priority order, deduped, deterministic, children first
type ClosureError struct { Bound string; Limit int64 }
type MissingError struct { Digest Digest }
func ServiceRoot(serviceID string) (string, error)
func Open(root string) (*Store, error)
func (s *Store) Put(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, media string) (Ref, error)          // manifest ref; writes only absent chunks
func (s *Store) PutBlob(ctx context.Context, b []byte) (Ref, error)
func (s *Store) PutGroup(ctx context.Context, media string, deps []Ref) (Ref, error)      // refuses absent deps
func (s *Store) Manifest(ctx context.Context, ref Ref) (Manifest, error)
func (s *Store) Open(ctx context.Context, ref Ref) (io.ReadCloser, error)                 // re-hashes every chunk
func (s *Store) Materialize(ctx context.Context, ref Ref, path string, perm os.FileMode) error
func (s *Store) Has(ctx context.Context, digests []Digest) (missing []Digest, err error)
func (s *Store) Closure(ctx context.Context, roots []Ref, bound ClosureBound) (Closure, error)
func (s *Store) Complete(ctx context.Context, roots []Ref) (missing int, err error)        // per-call closure presence + size check
func (s *Store) Verify(ctx context.Context, roots []Ref) error                             // full re-hash scrub
func (s *Store) SetPins(ctx context.Context, owner string, roots []Ref) error              // atomic whole-set replace; empty removes
func (s *Store) Pins(ctx context.Context) ([]PinSet, error)
func (s *Store) GC(ctx context.Context) (GCReport, error)                                  // mark = union of pin closures; sweep unreachable older than GCGrace; drop staging older than StagingTTL
// source side
func (s *Store) BuildBatch(ctx context.Context, objects []Digest) (BatchDescriptor, error)
func (s *Store) ReadPart(ctx context.Context, id Digest, index int) ([]byte, error)
func (s *Store) DropBatch(ctx context.Context, id Digest) error
// receive side
func (s *Store) BeginBatch(ctx context.Context, d BatchDescriptor) (haveParts []int, err error) // idempotent; admission ≤ MaxIncoming
func (s *Store) PutPart(ctx context.Context, id Digest, index int, data []byte) error          // len + sha256 must equal Parts[index]; durable write
func (s *Store) CommitBatch(ctx context.Context, id Digest) (CommitReport, error)             // every part present; bounded decode; verify kind/digest/size per object in order; manifests validated strictly; absent objects durably created, present ones mtime-touched; staging removed
type PartRef struct { Digest Digest `json:"digest"`; Size int64 `json:"size"` }
type BatchDescriptor struct { ID Digest `json:"id"`; Schema string `json:"schema"` /* synckit.artifact.batch.v1 */; Codec string `json:"codec"` /* zstd */; RawSize int64 `json:"raw_size"`; Objects []ObjectEntry `json:"objects"`; Parts []PartRef `json:"parts"` }
type CommitReport struct { Stored int `json:"stored"`; Present int `json:"present"`; Bytes int64 `json:"bytes"` }
```
- Pack stream v1: "SKP1", then per object {kind byte (1 blob, 2 manifest), 32-byte raw digest, uvarint size, bytes}, then 0x00 terminator and exact EOF. Encoder: one per Store, `zstd.NewWriter(nil, WithEncoderLevel(SpeedFastest), WithEncoderConcurrency(1), WithWindowSize(WindowSize), WithEncoderCRC(true))`, reset per batch under a mutex, streaming into outbox part files. Decoder: `WithDecoderConcurrency(1), WithDecoderLowmem(true), WithDecoderMaxWindow(WindowSize), WithDecoderMaxMemory(MaxBatchRaw + framing)`, wrapped in `io.LimitReader(RawSize+1)` with an exact-length check. Dependency: github.com/klauspost/compress (latest v1.x).
- Disk layout (dirs 0700, files 0600): store.lock, objects/<d[0:2]>/<digest>, pins/<sha256(owner)>.json, outbox/<batch-id>/{descriptor.json,NNNN.part}, incoming/<batch-id>/{descriptor.json,NNNN.part}. Durable writes through daemonkit durable (WriteFile/Create/Commit/Rename/RemoveTree). Merkle-closed invariant: an object is present only after its content is durable; Complete checks the whole closure.
- `func Register(d *rpc.Dispatcher, s *Store, monitor netpolicy.Monitor)`; `var Methods []string`. All handlers use d.Register (concurrent; never exclusive):
  - `synckit.net.status.v1` {} → {state: netpolicy.State} (control, < 1 KiB, always allowed)
  - `synckit.artifact.closure.v1` {roots, after, limit ≤ MaxClosurePage} → {objects, next, done, total_objects, total_bytes}
  - `synckit.artifact.have.v1` {digests ≤ MaxHaveDigests} → {missing}
  - `synckit.artifact.batch.build.v1` {objects} → BatchDescriptor
  - `synckit.artifact.batch.read.v1` {id, index} → {data}
  - `synckit.artifact.batch.drop.v1` {id} → {}
  - `synckit.artifact.batch.begin.v1` {batch: BatchDescriptor, sender: netpolicy.State} → {have_parts, peer: netpolicy.State} | typed paused error (R1)
  - `synckit.artifact.batch.put.v1` {id, index, data, sender: netpolicy.State} → {peer: netpolicy.State} | typed paused error (R1; evaluated BEFORE the write, every call)
  - `synckit.artifact.batch.commit.v1` {id} → CommitReport
  - `synckit.artifact.pins.set.v1` {owner, roots} → {}
  - The paused error carries `netpolicy.Evaluate(receiverLive, sender).Reason` with a stable code so the sender maps it to a PauseReason (peer-* vs local-*).
  - All JSON tags snake_case.

## 3. netpolicy (implemented; reviewed at 1215e002)
Use exactly: `State{status, expensive, constrained, cellular, manual_metered, observed_at}`, `State.Unrestricted()`, `Evaluate(local, remote) Verdict{Allowed, Reason}`, `Monitor.Current() (State, <-chan struct{})`, `NewMonitor(manualPath)`, `ManualPath()`, `LoadManual/SaveManual`, `Gate.Check/Wait`, `*PausedError`. Add the CLI: `synckitd net status [--json]` (local State + Evaluate against each mesh peer's reported state when reachable) and `synckitd net metered on|off` (SaveManual). Wait's remote-error behavior stays as implemented (returns the error); the deliverer treats it as `peer-unreachable` pause and re-polls.

## 4. syncservice changes
```go
const (
  MethodExportV2 = "synckit.syncservice.export.v2"
  MethodApplyV2  = "synckit.syncservice.apply.v2"
)
// ChangeEnvelope gains:
Artifacts []artifact.Ref `json:"artifacts,omitempty"` // roots, consumer priority order, unique, ≤ artifact.MaxRoots
// ApplyResult gains (v2 only):
Stale      bool   `json:"stale,omitempty"`       // receiver already holds a receipt ≥ source from this origin
HeldDigest string `json:"held_digest,omitempty"`
Partial    bool   `json:"partial,omitempty"`     // catalog recorded, not every root complete; AckedRevision is the prior receipt
func NewExportedArtifactChange(serviceID, schema string, kind ChangeKind, base, source Revision, payload []byte, roots []artifact.Ref) (ChangeEnvelope, error)
type ArtifactConsumer interface {
  SyncConsumer
  ExportArtifacts(ctx context.Context, request ExportRequest) (ChangeEnvelope, error)
  ApplyArtifacts(ctx context.Context, change ChangeEnvelope, ready []artifact.Ref) (ApplyResult, error)
}
func RegisterArtifactConsumer(d *rpc.Dispatcher, svc ArtifactConsumer, store *artifact.Store, monitor netpolicy.Monitor)
func ArtifactCapabilities(name string) Capabilities // AllMethods + v2 + artifact.Methods
type Receipt struct { Origin string; ChangeID string; Revision Revision; PayloadDigest string } // snake_case json
type FenceDecision int // FenceApply | FenceReplay | FenceStale | FenceNeedSnapshot
func Fence(held *Receipt, change ChangeEnvelope) (FenceDecision, ApplyResult, error)
func (ChangeEnvelope) Receipt() Receipt
func (*Client) ExportV2/ApplyV2/NetStatus/ArtifactClosure/ArtifactHave/BatchBuild/BatchRead/BatchDrop/BatchBegin/BatchPut/BatchCommit/PinsSet(...)
```
- BindDelivery: no Artifacts → unchanged (v1 goldens byte-identical). With Artifacts → domain `synckit.syncservice.change.v2`, hashing v1 inputs + root count + each root `kind:digest:size` (R2).
- v1 export/apply handlers and `Client.Apply` refuse any change carrying Artifacts (an old peer can never silently strip them; the new names fail loudly on old peers → `peer-incompatible`).
- apply.v2 handler (exclusive, like v1 apply): validate; for each root compute completeness from the local store (`Complete`), never trusting params; call ApplyArtifacts(change, ready); if the consumer returns AckedRevision == SourceRevision while any root is incomplete → error (R4); pin accepted roots under owner `synckit.accepted/<origin>` (union-then-narrow around the consumer call).
- Artifact services always export ChangeSnapshot (catalog small; artifacts dedupe by have).
- Fence: nil receipt → Apply; exact replay (same ChangeID/revision/digest) → Replay {Acked: held}; source ≤ held → Stale {Acked: held, HeldDigest}; delta base ≠ held → NeedSnapshot; else Apply. Consumers persist the receipt atomically with a complete apply only.

## 5. Delivery state v2 (daemon, owned by synckitd)
- Files under hostregistry.Mesh.Dir(): delivery-v2.json, delivery-v2.lock, delivery-v2/pending/<change_id>.json. Identity `synckit-delivery-v2`, version 2, strict decode.
- `deliveryRecord{service_id, peer, generation, acked_revision, acked_change_id, acked_at, pending *pendingRef{change_id, kind, base_revision, source_revision, roots []artifact.Ref, staged_at, superseded}}`.
- `stage(ctx, peer, expected, change)`: atomic expected-ChangeID CAS ("" = none); requires source > Acked; a replacement must be a ChangeSnapshot with source > old pending source; Acked untouched; pending envelope file written durably first, then the record swap in one durable write under the lock; old pending file removed after; orphans swept on load.
- `acknowledge(ctx, peer, change, ack)`: only when Pending.ChangeID == change.ChangeID; Acked = max(Acked, source); any other ChangeID → errPendingChanged with nothing mutated (R3).
- One-shot migration: v2 absent + delivery-v1.json present → under v2 then v1 locks, strict-read v1, carry Acked, drop v1 Pending, write v2, remove v1. Documented no-downgrade.

## 6. Deliverer (daemon/deliverer.go)
- One worker goroutine per (service, peer) in synckitd serve (the sole remote deliverer); coalescing dirty flag (a kick during a run triggers exactly one more run); workers belong to a supervisor generation (reload cancels).
- deliverOnce:
  1. load record + pending.
  2. STAGE (local only; runs while the peer is offline/paused/backing off): fresh := ExportV2(since Acked) (or v1 Export for non-artifact services); fresh.Source < max(Acked, pending.Source) → errSourceRegressed; no pending && fresh.Source == Acked → idle; no pending → stage(""); pending && same source → keep; pending && newer → supersede with a full snapshot (stage(expected=pending.ChangeID)); pins on the local consumer store: pins.set("synckit.delivery/<peer>", old ∪ new) → stage → pins.set(new only).
  3. GATE: local := synckitd monitor.Current(); peer := NetStatus(); Evaluate(local, peer) not allowed → paused(reason); NetStatus failure → paused(peer-unreachable); artifact change && peer capabilities lack v2/artifact methods → paused(peer-incompatible).
  4. TRANSFER pending.Artifacts in priority order: local closure paging → peer have (≤ MaxHaveDigests) → greedy batches ≤ 32 MiB raw / ≤ 16384 objects in priority order → local batch.build → peer batch.begin (resume from have_parts) → per missing part: re-check local monitor (its change channel cancels the in-flight ctx) and last peer state, local batch.read, peer batch.put (R1 receiver check) → peer batch.commit → local batch.drop. Pause → abandon (receiver staging expires by TTL or resumes via have_parts) → paused. After a committed batch that newly completes ≥ 1 root: progressive ApplyV2 (expect Partial; throttled to one per such batch).
  5. APPLY: ack := ApplyV2 (Apply v1 for non-artifact services). NeedSnapshot → re-stage full snapshot (expected = pending.ChangeID), repeat 4–5 once. Stale && Acked == pending.Source && HeldDigest == pending.PayloadDigest → treat as acknowledged. Stale otherwise → errSourceRegressed. Partial → errIncomplete (backoff). Acked == pending.Source → acknowledge; pins.set("synckit.delivery/<peer>", nil).
- Errors back off 30 s → 5 min cap (down/recover logs + tailscale snapshot move here from breakerNotifier for peers); pauses never escalate backoff and wake on monitor change or a 60 s re-check.
- manifestNotifier.Notify for a peer → scheduler.Kick; the self path keeps local Reconcile. The launchd `synckitd reconcile` CLI never delivers itself: it calls the daemon rpc delivery.kick (error if the daemon is down); the in-daemon reconcile rpc calls scheduler.Kick.
- 10 s coalescing comes from the consumer manifest `watch.debounce: "10s"` on its single stamp WatchItem.

## 7. Delivery status (public package github.com/yasyf/synckit/delivery)
```go
type State string       // idle | staged | transferring | applying | paused | backoff
type PauseReason string // local-disconnected | local-unknown | local-cellular | local-expensive | local-constrained | local-manual-metered |
                        // peer-disconnected | peer-unknown | peer-cellular | peer-expensive | peer-constrained | peer-manual-metered |
                        // peer-unreachable | peer-incompatible
type Pending struct { ChangeID string; Kind syncservice.ChangeKind; BaseRevision, SourceRevision syncservice.Revision; Roots int; StagedAt time.Time; Superseded uint64 }
type Progress struct { RootsTotal, RootsComplete int; ObjectsMissing, ObjectsSent, BytesMissing, BytesSent, WireBytesSent, InFlightLimit int64; EnumerationDone bool } // InFlightLimit = artifact.PartSize (honest bound after a pause is observed)
type PeerStatus struct { ServiceID, Peer string; Generation uint64; Acked syncservice.Revision; AckedChangeID string; AckedAt time.Time; Pending *Pending; State State; PauseReason PauseReason; PauseSince time.Time; LastError string; LastAttemptAt, NextAttemptAt time.Time; Progress Progress; LocalNetwork, PeerNetwork *netpolicy.State }
func Status(ctx context.Context, serviceID string) ([]PeerStatus, error) // "" = all services; dials synckitd
func Kick(ctx context.Context, serviceID, peer string) error             // peer "" = every mesh host
```
- Daemon handlers `delivery.status` and `delivery.kick` (plain Register). Durable fields from delivery-v2; State/Progress/PauseReason/LastError are a live overlay (after restart: staged if Pending else idle). The serve label/client spec moves into an internal package shared by daemon and delivery.
- Assurance: a consumer revision is durable on peer P only if ≤ PeerStatus.Acked for P. Progress/RootsComplete/Partial are informational, never assurance. Docs must state the honest limits (in-flight part ≤ PartSize after a pause is observed; unmarked cellular backhaul reads unrestricted unless manually metered).

## 8. Tests (required, beyond per-file unit tests)
v1 goldens byte-identical + v2 goldens + v2 ChangeID vector (roots change the id; no roots reproduce v1); validation table (dup/too many/invalid roots; artifacts on v1 paths refused); Fence table; apply.v2 refuses a consumer ACK with a missing closure; store: 9 MiB+1 B file → chunks, append 100 B changes only last chunk + manifest; PutGroup refuses absent deps; pack round trip, ErrBatchFull past 32 MiB, flipped byte rejected and nothing stored, zstd bomb rejected within decoder memory bound, manifest before chunk rejected; batch begin/put/commit: offset/hash mismatch rejected, interrupted batch resumes from have_parts, missing part never commits, staging TTL sweep; receiver R1: put refused when the receiver's live state flips to cellular mid-batch even though the sender's cached peer state says unrestricted, begin refused when the sender declares cellular; pins/GC; delivery store: migration, CAS, supersede rules, stale ACK after supersede → errPendingChanged with Pending unchanged, monotonic Acked, orphan sweep, strict decode; deliverer with fake local/peer consumers over in-memory stores: offline peer → successive kicks supersede (one pending file, Superseded counter, Acked unchanged, delivery pins = latest roots only); every local-* and peer-* pause reason → zero have/batch/apply calls, status paused with exact reason, net.status still called; transition to unrestricted resumes without a new kick; pause mid-transfer stops within one part (WireBytesSent delta ≤ PartSize); NeedSnapshot re-stage; Stale equal-digest acks; Partial no ack; missing/corrupt part no ack and pending retained; replay idempotent; 40 kicks in a window → ≤ 2 runs per peer; unchanged content → zero upload bytes and zero payload when Source == Acked; priority order respected; relay B→C with A's transport failed; delivery.status/kick via rpctest; no concurrent deliverOnce for one (service, peer) under -race. Gates: go vet ./..., go test -race ./..., go build ./..., golangci-lint.
ops.when: Implementing or reviewing synckit artifact/netpolicy/syncservice v2/delivery changes or a consumer using them (cc-sync)
